a.lede: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 to ChatGPT, and it will come with the capability to build more visual responses.
a.title: GPT-6 is coming to all tiers of ChatGPT

b.lede: OpenAI is launching a new Intelligent UI feature in ChatGPT that allows the chatbot to answer your questions with interactive visuals. The update, which is rolling out to all users alongside GPT-6, gives ChatGPT the ability to combine a text response with diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons, and more.
